SELECT 'sales' t, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d1, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, MIN(sale_date) mn, MAX(sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'prodver', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku), SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), MIN(valid_from), MAX(valid_from) FROM dim_product
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cur_dup', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sku), 0, NULL, NULL FROM dim_product WHERE is_current

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.cost),2) AS cost,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),1) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 14

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999
), a AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns FROM net_lines n
  WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND n.store_id IN (106,107,108,109,110,111,112,113,114,137) GROUP BY 1
), b AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) rs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND store_id IN (106,107,108,109,110,111,112,113,114,137) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(a.store_id,b.store_id) store_id, a.ns, b.rs, ROUND(a.ns-b.rs,2) diff FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.store_id=b.store_id ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_cost,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount IS NULL OR f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad_net,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_mismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost > f.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_gt_net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id IN (106,107,108,109,110,111,112,113,114,137)
